{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Raincoat with a tailored silhouette reaching mid-calf in charcoal grey (#3e4a4d), made of water-resistant technical wool blend.
Knitted blouse with a relaxed fit in navy blue (#2c3e50), featuring fine ribbed texture and elbow-length sleeves in soft cotton-wool mix.
Straight-leg trousers in dark denim (#1a252f) with a clean crease down the front, cut from sturdy but stretchable twill fabric for ease of movement.
Ankle boots with a low block heel in deep brown leather (#4e3629), providing stable support and protection against wet pavement.
This outfit perfectly balances professional polish with practical warmth for an entire day of rain while meeting the requirements of a client meeting at a cafe. The structured outer layer shields from the autumn chill without adding bulk, ensuring comfort during long conversations or walks. Neutral tones like charcoal, navy, and brown create a sophisticated palette that flatters her skin tone and maintains context-appropriate elegance."}
